Constraint Preventing Direct Compliance: Legacy system cannot support current authentication standards without a costly upgrade
Objective of Original Requirement: Ensure only authorized users can authenticate to system components
Identified Risk if Requirement Not Met: Unauthorized access to legacy system storing account data
Compensating Control Description: Network segmentation isolating legacy system + compensating monitoring/logging of all access attempts
How Compensating Control Meets the Objec: Reduces exposure to only pre-authorized network segment with full audit trail of access
Additional Risk Introduced by Compensati: Requires ongoing segmentation validation to remain effective
